topics.title: FastEdge Platform Overview
topics.description: Gcore FastEdge runs WebAssembly (Wasm) workloads at the edge on Gcore's global CDN infrastructure. When a request arrives at a PoP, the Wasm runtime instantiates the app, processes the request, and returns the response — all within the same PoP, minimizing latency.
